payload.core_mechanism_summary: Exhaustively generates all reachable numbers by enumerating all possible Add operations (0-9) and all cyclic shifts, then selects the lexicographically smallest.
payload.rationale: The solution simulates all combinations of Add and Rotate operations (commutative) to explore the full state space, then picks the minimal string. No pruning or backtracking used; closest subtype is brute-force complete search.
